background_setting: A rural two-lane paved road under a clear blue daytime sky. The ego lane and the empty oncoming lane are separated by a broken white centre line. Grey asphalt shows subtle wear and consistent shadow patterns cast across the surface. Flat, open terrain flanks both sides of the road with low grass verges and occasional distant vegetation. The horizon is bright and the visibility is excellent, with a straight stretch of road extending ahead.

actions.description: The ego vehicle travels straight along its lane, approaching three white stickers arranged in a diagonal line on the pavement. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle begins steering left, following the angled sticker line rather than the true straight lane markings. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle crosses the centre line into the empty oncoming lane and slows down sharply, maintaining the leftward position. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
